text:
Maya (Sales): FYI — Velora Bank just pushed a security intake. They attached a SIG/CAIQ plus a separate PCI questionnaire. Main asks: HSM-backed keys, audit logs, and proof of controls. POC kickoff aiming for 2025-03-10. Can security own intake and estimate timelines? Link: https://drive.redwood/velora/sec-intake
Arjun (Security): On it. Please paste the questionnaire link and confirm whether Velora will send real PANs during the POC or tokenized data. Need to triage scope first.
Maya (Sales): Link above includes both docs. Customer note: "POC will process test transactions but may share masked PANs; production would require full tokenization and HSM for key custody." They also asked if Redwood can do BYOK with their HSM vendor later.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Quick notes: 
- If they insist on vendor HSM attestation (FIPS/FIPS+), production likely requires Private or Dedicated with HSM integration.
- For Hosted we offer CMK via cloud KMS (customer-managed keys) but not attested HSM appliances by default.
Can you confirm expected TPS and retention window? Sizing matters for Dedicated vs Private.
Arjun (Security): Assigning this to security. I'm starting SIG mapping now. Initial answers for the SIG/CAIQ: ETA ~48 hours for draft. HSM attestation and vendor paperwork: that's a separate infra/legal flow, estimate 5-10 business days depending on vendor responsiveness. Flags: PCI scope if Redwood stores PAN = needs QSA involvement.
Maya (Sales): Noted. For the POC they said "test tokens" preferred but may want a short run with masked PANs. I'll push them to tokenized sandbox.
Tara (Legal): Quick legal check: we need signed DPA + PCI addendum before any real PANs touch our systems. For POC we can accept tokenized data under current DPA. If Velora wants us to store PANs, we'll require an assessment and formal addendum. Who's owning the addendum?
Arjun (Security): Security will start the intake packet and produce draft responses. I'll also create a ticket for the HSM evidence request. Ticket: SEC-2025-77.
deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4821 for infra follow-up (HSM evaluation & vendor attestation).
Evan (Infra Eng): Picking this up from INF-4821. Quick reality check: acquiring HSM attestation (vendor cert + integration) is non-trivial. For short-term POC we can provision customer-managed CMKs in their VPC and enable audit logs (Cloud KMS + Cloud Audit) — this satisfies most audit evidence except on-prem HSM attestation. ETA for a POC-ready CMK + logging hookup: 2-3 business days. Full HSM vendor attestation: estimate 10 business days and coordination with Velora's vendor.
Devon (Solutions Eng): For the POC path I'll propose: tokenized test traffic -> Hosted with CMK in customer's cloud project (BYOK) OR Dedicated sandbox with CMK in colo if they require stricter isolation. I'll draft a short checklist for Sales to send to Velora: 
- Expected TPS (avg/peak)
- Retention window for transaction records
- Whether any PAN will be stored with Redwood in prod
- Preferred KMS vendor (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / HSM vendor)
Maya (Sales): I'll collect those from the customer today. Also pinging their security contact @velora-sec to confirm vendor.
Arjun (Security): Status update plan: I'll post draft SIG answers in 48h and attach supporting artifacts (SOC2 mapping, KMS architecture diagram). If legal confirms DPA addendum needed, tag @Tara. Marking this thread as assigned to Security (Arjun) and Infra (Evan) for HSM.
Tara (Legal): I'll prepare a template PCI addendum and share if they confirm PAN-in-scope. For POC, tokenized flow is fine — keep me posted.
Maya (Sales): Great, thanks. I'll update Velora with: tokenized POC recommended, draft SIG responses in 48h, potential 10 business day path for HSM evidence if they need it post-POC.
Arjun (Security): Created SEC ticket and linked docs. Next steps: 1) Security draft (48h) 2) Sales to confirm TPS + vendor (today) 3) Infra to scope HSM (INF-4821) — Evan please update ETA in ticket.
Evan (Infra Eng): Will update INF-4821 with a vendor engagement plan and ETA 10bd for full attestation. For now, offering CMK in customer's cloud for the POC.
Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll loop back once Velora sends TPS + vendor details.
Arjun (Security): Noted. Leaving the thread open for any follow-ups.
